notes:
## Minecraft 26.2 compatibility
Updated the mod metadata to allow Minecraft **26.1.2 through 26.2.x**. The release JAR is built and verified on Minecraft 26.1.2; 26.2 compatibility is declared by the mod metadata but was not separately client-tested in CI. The mod icon is included.

## CustomScoreboard compatibility
Updated and tested against **meowdding/CustomScoreboard 1.12.14-2 for Minecraft 26.1.x**. Money and cookies use its read-only, unrounded purse balance while retained coins keep its chosen localized/compact representation.

Supports Purse/Piggy, native label placements, long/short number formats, chunked purse, the legacy-string formatter and Hypixel Lines. Conversion is applied before the native builder measures and arranges its widgets; gain text and original coin styles remain intact. Native SkyBlock context keeps quote refresh active when a replacement sidebar is used. No balance API or server scoreboard data is modified.

## SkyHanni profit displays
Adds optional integration with **SkyHanni 7.56.0 for Minecraft 26.1.x** for semantic coin formatting in supported profit/value displays, while leaving generic numbers, resource costs, item counts and underlying arithmetic unchanged. Existing display order, layout, precision, currency and visibility settings apply.

## Verification
All unit and integration checks in the selected build passed, including the actual Fabric client rendering smoke test. The selected artifact is the exact tested JAR, not a rebuild. Test fixtures are excluded from the published JAR.

These are synthetic fixtures in the real clients, **not an authenticated Hypixel playtest**. The named dependency versions are verified; arbitrary future versions and every mod-drawn number are not claimed.

## Installation
Replace the old JAR with **coins-to-money-1.2.4.jar**, keeping only one version installed. Existing settings are retained. CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni and Kotlin remain optional and are not bundled; install each optional mod's normal dependencies when using it.

Requires **Minecraft 26.1.2 through 26.2.x**, **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
